texts:
Marketing & Brand Development Intern
Gurugram, India · June - August 2026
I built the guest list, set up the space (racks, flowers, layout) and watched customers live. Co-ord sets drew the most attention: physical retail tests products in a way analytics cannot.

I already bring
creative retail concept work and hands-on marketing.

I want from ESMOD
strategy, luxury brand management, consumer behaviour and retail strategy.

Projects I want to join
Build Up My Brand and Business Marathon: to go beyond studying how brands work and take part in building one.

Goal
luxury brand strategy, then building my own brand.

Skills
Event planning
Guest outreach
Visual merchandising
Reading customer behaviour

founded 6 October 1961 by André Courrèges, Coqueline Courrèges and Marcel Leyrat - all former colleagues at Balenciaga
a silhouette that defined a decade

white, geometric cuts round finishes, vinyl the miniskirt
a heritage about
the future, not
the past

under Nicolas Di Felice (2020-2026), a young, fashion-literate
Paris crowd with
club-culture energy
McCall's, Fall-Winter 1965-66: 'the look of Courrèges' sold as sewing patterns. Copies, not originals. Photos: Edward Pfizenmaier.

1965: Courrèges stopped presenting collections because of mass copies – the ‘look of Courrèges’ was being sold as
sewing patterns

texts:
codes 
so clear, always in style.
↑ Courrèges End of Year 2025 campaign, photographed by Sam Rock

di felice rebuilt the brand from 
the logo to the stores while respecting 
the archive.

codes so clear 
that every new 
designer inherits 
a ready-made 
visual language.

can the revival survive two pressures at once – a new designer, 
drew henry
(debut SS27, september 2026), 
and an owner under debt pressure that does not publish the house's accounts?

grow through experience rather than many stores – fewer, more distinctive spaces and events, 
the way NOVA 
is built.

minimal campaigns 
by sam rock
turn the carré 
magique into 
a set.

texts:
Born in tunis, 1935.
studied sculpture,
in paris from 1957.

Two outsiders who made Paris
their own.

treated the body
like a sculpture.

reshaped balenciaga's
image and identity.
first gucci collection:
la famiglia, shot by
catherine opie.

refused the fashion
calendar. why him:
shape as identity,
logo or no logo.

why him: alaïa built
shape on the body;
demna uses oversized
silhouettes to build
image and brand.

with the logo removed,
is the image still luxury?

texts:
When a designer moves,
does desire move with them -
or stay with the house?

caveat:
searches measure attention,
listings measure supply.
signals, not proof of a cause.

desire splits.

the designer carries attention;
the house keeps
its archive.

a creative director acts as a curator of the house’s past.
